welcome_message_3: I execute IT and creative projects.
welcome_message_4: Let's grab a coffee & get to work❗
wip_banner_body: This site is being built live; things may change or break.
alt_tokyo_tower_mori_art_museum: Tokyo Tower shot from Mori Art Museum
alt_ueteliberg_kindergarten: School class playing on a snowy hill
ask_try_again: Do you want to try again?
harmonia_tagline: Keep your floating island in balance.
harmonia_intro_body: Grow a settlement of at least {population} people and keep harmony at {harmony} or more until the end of year {years}. Food, water and energy have to last without wrecking nature and air. Shortage hurts, and so does waste.
harmonia_intro_rule_1: Each turn is a season. Build as much as your materials allow, then end the season.
harmonia_intro_rule_2: The weakest value drags harmony down: balance beats excellence.
harmonia_intro_rule_3: Ore, groundwater and forest run out. What you use up today is missing tomorrow.
harmonia_intro_rule_4: Your settlement has no power yet. Start with wind or sun.
harmonia_sinking_warning: The island is sinking! Lift harmony above {threshold} or it goes under in {count} seasons.
harmonia_tool_inspect_desc: Hover a tile to see what is happening there.
harmonia_tool_upgrade_desc: Improve a building: denser, cleaner or more efficient, without taking new land.
harmonia_tool_plant_desc: Turns meadow or wasteland into young forest. Forest binds pollution, refills groundwater and shelters wildlife.
harmonia_tool_clear_desc: Fells a forest for materials and space, at the cost of nature, water and clean air.
harmonia_tool_demolish_desc: Tears a building down and returns half its materials.
harmonia_building_house_desc: Homes for 10 people. More residents need more of everything.
harmonia_upgrade_house: Eco block: room for 22 on the same land
harmonia_building_farm_desc: Plenty of food, but a monoculture: thirsty, polluting and hard on wildlife.
harmonia_upgrade_farm: Greenhouse: higher yield, drip irrigation, needs power
harmonia_building_garden_desc: Smaller harvest, but close to nature. Each neighbouring forest brings pollinators and +1 food (up to +2).
harmonia_building_coal_desc: Lots of power in any weather, but heavily polluting. Burns through the mountain’s ore.
harmonia_building_wind_desc: Clean power, strongest in autumn and winter. Also stands on mountains.
harmonia_building_solar_desc: Clean power, strong in summer and weak in winter. Ideal on wasteland.
harmonia_building_mine_desc: Materials from the mountain. Once the ore is gone, only wasteland remains.
harmonia_building_sawmill_desc: Materials from the forest. Only sustainable deep in the woods: every neighbouring forest speeds regrowth.
harmonia_building_waterworks_desc: Pumps drinking water from the groundwater. Rain and forests refill it.
harmonia_upgrade_waterworks: Water cycle: treats wastewater and spares the groundwater
harmonia_building_recycling_desc: Recovers materials from waste and lowers pollution.
harmonia_upgrade_recycling: Circular hub: more materials, cleaner air
harmonia_building_park_desc: A place to unwind: lifts happiness and shelters wildlife (up to 3 parks count).
harmonia_log_ore_exhausted: The ore has run out and left wasteland behind.
harmonia_log_forest_lost: A forest was cut down completely and is gone.
harmonia_log_groundwater_low: Groundwater is running low and lakes are drying up.
harmonia_log_shortage_water: Water shortage! {count} residents left the island.
harmonia_log_sinking: The island is starting to sink…
harmonia_log_event_drought: Drought: no rain this season, and the waterworks pump less.
harmonia_log_event_pests: Pests hit the farms and halve the harvest. Permaculture is spared.
harmonia_log_event_storm: A storm rolls in: turbines spin at full tilt, solar parks sit in shadow.
harmonia_log_event_heatwave: Heatwave: air conditioning hums, but the sun delivers extra power.
harmonia_log_event_wildfire: Wildfire! A forest burned down. Drought and smog make fires likelier.
harmonia_log_event_birds: Migrating birds stop over on the island, to everyone’s delight.
harmonia_log_event_smog: Smog alert! People stay indoors and grumble.
harmonia_log_event_tourists: Eco-tourists admire the island and bring 8 materials.
harmonia_event_investor_body: They want to open a strip mine and offer 15 materials. The pit would weigh heavily on air and nature.
harmonia_log_event_investor_accept: The strip mine is running: materials in hand, but air and nature suffer.
harmonia_log_event_investor_decline: You turned the strip mine down, and people are proud of it.
harmonia_event_grant_body: Researchers offer their support. Which technology should improve for good?
harmonia_log_event_grant_solar: New solar cells: every solar park now delivers more for good.
harmonia_log_event_grant_wind: New rotor blades: every turbine now delivers more for good.
harmonia_event_families_body: Families from the mainland want to move to your island. There is free housing, but more people need more food, water and power.
harmonia_log_event_families_accept: New families have arrived and been warmly welcomed.
harmonia_log_event_families_decline: The families move on. Some islanders are sorry to see it.
harmonia_event_timber_body: A trader wants to buy your finest forest for 12 materials. The forest would be gone for good.
harmonia_log_event_timber_accept: The forest has been sold and felled.
harmonia_log_event_timber_decline: The forest stays, and nature thanks you.
harmonia_won_body: For ten years you kept people and nature in balance.
harmonia_lost_sunk_body: Harmony stayed too low for too long. Without balance the island could no longer float.
harmonia_lost_empty_body: Without food, water and power, every resident has left.
harmonia_lost_goal_body: Ten years are up, but the goal ({population} residents and harmony {harmony}) was not reached.
harmonia_shortcuts: Keys: N next season · Z undo · Esc drop the tool. Your game saves automatically.
